mapper.insert: INSERT INTO production_insights ( id, row_version, created_at, project_id, chapter_id, observation_json, recommendation_text, status ) VALUES ( #{id,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{rowVersion}, #{createdAt}, #{projectId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{chapterId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, CAST(#{observationJson} AS JSONB), #{recommendationText}, #{status} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, row_version AS rowVersion, created_at AS createdAt, project_id AS projectId, chapter_id AS chapterId, observation_json::text AS observationJson, recommendation_text AS recommendationText, status FROM production_insights WHERE id = #{id,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}

SELECT id, row_version AS rowVersion, created_at AS createdAt, project_id AS projectId, chapter_id AS chapterId, observation_json::text AS observationJson, recommendation_text AS recommendationText, status FROM production_insights WHERE project_id = #{projectId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT id, row_version AS rowVersion, created_at AS createdAt, project_id AS projectId, chapter_id AS chapterId, observation_json::text AS observationJson, recommendation_text AS recommendationText, status FROM production_insights WHERE chapter_id = #{chapterId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} ORDER BY created_at DESC
